Changelog:
v1.0.4.18 - Stop the unconditional AutoDuty yield. The v1.0.4.13 yield logic was way too aggressive: it shut down Gluttony autorotation for the entire duration of AutoDuty running a duty (combat, navigation, all of it), not just during mechanics. Joey hit this immediately - Gluttony auto mode did nothing while AutoDuty was active, then started working again the second AutoDuty stopped. The yield gate has been removed from ShouldSkipAutorotation; autorotation now runs normally during AutoDuty operations.

Pyretic safety from v1.0.4.17 remains intact via NoActStatus (status IDs 960 / 1387 / 2127), gated at both ShouldSkipAutorotation AND UseActionDetour. That is the actual mechanism that protects the player during Pyretic - the AutoDuty yield was a workaround for the same problem but with collateral damage.

If the target-fighting issue (Gluttony retargeting after AutoDuty clears the target during untarget mechanics) becomes a real problem in practice, we will reintroduce a finer-grained gate scoped to those specific mechanics rather than blanket-yielding whenever AutoDuty is running.
